comment: Name-binding table of the RR proxy for the Streamline 2.7.1 interposer (spec 60-63 annexes A9, A10). Export names and ordinals: rr-f-sl-interposer-exports.json (crossed spec data A9.3, names and ordinals only). Roles: A9.4. Version magic: A9.1. Binding: by name, ordinals kept (A9.2). The three RR feature-function names (A9.5) are in rr-functions.json and the game's interposer file name in interposer.json; proxy_file_name / probe_file_name are the built output names of the file-replacement proxy (the install tool copies the chosen one under the interposer file name; tools/build.py --proxy-name overrides); hook_file_name / hook_probe_file_name are the built names of the hook-mode plugin, loaded by OptiScaler from its plugins folder (HOOK-MODE.md). GUIDs: A9.6 (viewport and tag are matched; frame_token is checked by the probe build; the others name structures in the probe log).
file_version_comment: version number other mods read from the interposer file (VERSIONINFO FILEVERSION / PRODUCTVERSION and the FileVersion / ProductVersion strings of every build, release and probe): the game's interposer version of this table, api_version plus .0
